[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:385YE Autumn]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Mitwold, Seconded: Kallavesa">Motion to dredge the Westmere at Meade March, Mitwold. This commission will result in the creation of 2 ministries. The first, a mithril ministry in Meade, to be held by the 'Alder of Meade' liaison to the Tseriyn family of Faraden. This would be an annually elected Marcher Bourse position. The second, an ilium ministry in Fisk, Kallavesa, to be held by the 'Mediator of Fisk'. Both to be appointed by the tally of votes. We have secured funding.</quote>
==Overview==
* Creates a [[ministry]] in [[Mitwold]] and a ministry in [[Kallavesa]] as per the '''[[Butterfly_in_reverse#Dredging_the_Westmere|Butterfly in reverse]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed
==Date==
* Autumn 385YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per the wind of fortune
* 50 wains of weirwood
* 30 wains of white granite
* 30 thrones
* Six months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Dredge_the_Westmere}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete, the position of [[Alder of Meade]] will be available to elect by [[Tally of the Votes]] by the owners of [[farm|farms]] in [[the Marches]] and the position of [[Mediator of Fisk]] will be available to elect by Tally of the Votes by the commanders of [[military unit|military units]] in [[Wintermark]]
* Now that work on this commission is complete Meade March in [[Mitwold]] has gained the coastal quality. There has been an overall seasonal increase of nine thrones in taxation from [[Bregasland]], [[Kallavesa]], and [[Mitwold]]
